title: [dogfood-smoke] Controlled fixture smoke candidate
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Exercise the controlled dogfood smoke preflight path in fixture mode.

## Why Now

Operators need a deterministic credential-free way to verify the controlled dogfood smoke candidate path before running the live GitHub Project v2 smoke.

## Issue Context

This issue is loaded by `examples/dogfood-smoke-workflow.md`. It intentionally carries the `dogfood-smoke` label and a `[dogfood-smoke]` title marker so `dogfood-smoke` can count it as the one controlled candidate.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Keep this issue fixture-only and dry-run only.
- Use one controlled candidate so the preflight can report the expected count.

### Assumptions

- Fixture mode is enough to rehearse candidate filtering and quality-gate evaluation.

## Dependencies

- No blocking dependencies.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not perform live GitHub Project v2 writes from this fixture.
- Do not treat fixture readiness as supervised live dogfood completion.
- Do not move work to Human Review.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Controlled smoke preflight candidate detection.
- Issue Quality Gate evaluation.
- Operator-visible dry-run reporting.

### Out of Scope

- Live tracker mutation.
- Real backend execution.
- Review Agent execution.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- `Alive24/jade-symphony`

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- `docs/dogfood-smoke.md`
- `docs/dogfood-readiness.md`

### Relevant Code Paths

- `src/main.rs`
- `examples/dogfood-smoke-workflow.md`
- `examples/fixtures/dogfood-smoke-issues.json`

## Current State

The live dogfood smoke command exists, but this fixture provides a safe local candidate.

## Deliverable Shape

A dry-run smoke preflight report with one controlled executable candidate.

## Risks or Constraints

- Fixture mode must remain non-write-ready.

## Expected Outcome

The smoke preflight reports one controlled executable candidate and `write_ready=false`.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- `cargo run -- dogfood-smoke examples/dogfood-smoke-workflow.md --dry-run` reports `controlled_candidates=1` and `executable_candidates=1`.

### Functional Verification

- `cargo test`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm fixture smoke remains separate from live dogfood smoke.

title: Ordinary fixture issue outside controlled smoke
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Remain outside the controlled dogfood smoke candidate set.

## Why Now

The fixture should prove that ordinary Todo issues do not count as controlled dogfood smoke candidates.

## Issue Context

This issue is loaded by `examples/dogfood-smoke-workflow.md` but does not carry the `dogfood-smoke` label or title marker.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not count this issue as a controlled smoke candidate.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Candidate filtering fixture coverage.

### Out of Scope

- Live tracker mutation.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- `Alive24/jade-symphony`

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- `docs/dogfood-smoke.md`

### Relevant Code Paths

- `examples/fixtures/dogfood-smoke-issues.json`

## Current State

The fixture needs a non-controlled issue for contrast.

## Deliverable Shape

An ordinary Todo issue that is ignored by controlled smoke filtering.

## Risks or Constraints

- This issue must not accidentally include the smoke marker.

## Expected Outcome

The dry-run smoke command still reports exactly one controlled candidate.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- The fixture smoke command reports `controlled_candidates=1`.

### Functional Verification

- `cargo test`

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm the title and labels do not include the controlled smoke marker.
